name: agentic-rails
description: Agentic Rails marketplace: installable, lifecycle-managed verifiers and guardrails for agentic coding tools.

plugins.name: game-golden-screenshot-verifier
plugins.description: Runtime smoke verifier for games: launches the game, drives it into a deterministic state, captures a screenshot, and compares it against a versioned golden. Exit 0 pass / 1 fail.

plugins.name: wpf-visual-quality-gate
plugins.description: Evaluator-run visual quality gate for WPF desktop apps: an independent evaluator launches the app, drives the changed interaction with real input, and screenshot-verifies the result against explicit pass criteria.

plugins.name: quota-advisor-guardrail
plugins.description: Actor-critic guardrail for Claude Code: executor sessions must consult a stronger read-only advisor subagent before their first write, enforced deterministically by a PreToolUse hook. Claude Code only.
